drivingQuestion: What does 'אחד לא יעשנו שנים' prohibit?
outcomeNote: Rami bar Ḥama's reading rejected by Rava

segments.he: אֶחָד – לֹא יַעֲשֶׂנּוּ שְׁנַיִם. סָבַר רָמֵי בַּר חָמָא לְמֵימַר, בַּר אַרְבְּעֵי – לָא לִישַׁוְּיֵיהּ תְּרֵי בְּנֵי תַּרְתֵּי תַּרְתֵּי, דְּקָא שָׁקֵיל תַּמְנֵי בְּחָצֵר; אֲבָל בַּר תַּמְנֵי, לִישַׁוְּיֵיהּ בְּנֵי אַרְבְּעֵי אַרְבְּעֵי – שַׁפִּיר דָּמֵי; אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא, מָצֵי אֲמַר לֵיהּ: בְּחַד פִּיתְחָא מָצֵינָא אִצְטְנוֹעֵי מִינָּךְ, בִּתְרֵי לָא מָצֵינָא אִצְטְנוֹעֵי מִינָּךְ.
segments.en: The mishna teaches that if there «was one» entrance «he may not fashion it into two.» In this case as well, «Rami bar Ḥama thought to say» that this means if the entrance was the width «of four» cubits he «may not make it into two» openings, «each» the width «of two» cubits, «as» he would then be allowed to «take eight» corresponding cubits «in» the «courtyard,» four for each entrance. «But» if it was the width «of eight» cubits and he wishes «to make it into» two openings, «each» the width «of four» cubits, he may «well» do so, as in any event he already had the right to use an area of eight cubits by four cubits in front of his entrance. «Rava said to him:» This is not so, as his neighbor «can say to him: I can conceal» myself «from you with» there being «one entrance,» but «I cannot conceal» myself «from you with» there being «two entrances.»
